## Verdict

**Lumen Path** costs least for a team of 30, at **$270 per month**. All three vendors have minimums at or below 30 seats, so none of them force payment for unused capacity — the ranking here is decided purely by per-seat rate. Lumen Path's $9 is the lowest, and at this size it undercuts Estuary by $150 per month and Gable by $360 per month.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Gable | $21 | 1 |
| Lumen Path | $9 | 10 |
| Estuary | $14 | 25 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for = the greater of 30 (team size) or the vendor minimum. Every minimum (1, 10, 25) falls below 30, so all three bill for exactly 30 seats.

- **Lumen Path:** 30 × $9 = **$270 per month**
- **Estuary:** 30 × $14 = **$420 per month**
- **Gable:** 30 × $21 = **$630 per month**

Spread between cheapest and dearest: $360 per month, or $4,320 per year. Lumen Path is 57% cheaper than Gable and 36% cheaper than Estuary. Effective cost per person matches the list rate in every case, since no seats are wasted.

## Risks

- **Minimums are inactive at 30 but become live if the team shrinks.** Estuary's 25-seat floor means a drop to 20 people still bills $350 ($14 × 25), while Lumen Path would bill $180 ($9 × 20). Gable's 1-seat minimum makes it the only option with no floor exposure, though its rate is high enough that this does not make it competitive until roughly 12 people or fewer against Estuary.
- **Growth does not change the order.** All three scale linearly above 30 seats, so Lumen Path stays cheapest at any larger size on list price, and the absolute gap widens with each added seat.
- **Price only.** The list carries no feature, support, security, or usage-limit detail. A cheaper seat may buy a narrower product; this comparison cannot say.
- **Monthly list pricing assumed.** Annual commitments, volume discounts at 30+ seats, onboarding fees, and contract exit terms are not in the source and could reorder these totals — Gable has the most headroom to discount.
